### some performance examples 

:::: {.columns}

::: {.column style="width: 45%; margin-right: 9%"}

```{.gnuassembler style="border: 2px solid black; font-size: 100%;"}
example1:
  movq $10000000000, %rax
loop1:
  addq %rbx, %rcx
  decq %rax
  jge loop1
  ret
```

about _30B instructions_<br/>
my desktop: _2.65 sec_
:::


::: {.column style="width: 45%"}

```{.gnuassembler style="border: 2px solid black; font-size: 100%;"}
example1:
  movq $10000000000, %rax
loop1:
  addq %rbx, %rcx
  addq %r8,  %r9
  decq %rax
  jge loop1
  ret
```

about _40B instructions_<br/>
my desktop: _2.65 sec_


:::
